entries.title: DRAFT: repeated-site Ising cumulants vanish for delocalized block weights
entries.statement: DRAFT concept; author derivation, finite weighted/transitive bound independently kept by w476; broader block extension pending. Let sigma be mean-zero spin-flip-symmetric +/-1 spins, G(x,y)=E sigma_x sigma_y>=0, w_x>=0 finitely supported and nonzero, V=E(sum w_x sigma_x)^2. For q_x=w_x(sum_y w_y G(x,y))/V, sum q_x=1. Let D be the negative fourth-cumulant sum over ordered quadruples with a repeated site, weighted by the four w factors and divided by V^2. Then U4(x,x,y,z)=-2G(x,y)G(x,z), and 0<=D<=12sum q_x^2<=12max q_x<=12||w||_infinity/sqrt(V)<=12||w||_infinity/||w||_2. Uniform weights on a transitive N-site graph give D<=12/N; arbitrary N-site blocks give D<=12/sqrt(N). This removes exact coincidences only and does not prove critical 3D Ising non-triviality.

entries.title: DRAFT: no uniform proportional reverse of current sprinkling
entries.statement: DRAFT concept; special-case proof independently kept by w476; model/account diversity gate unverified. In zero-field ferromagnetic Ising on the path 0,...,3m with uniform beta>0, n1,n2 have source sets {0,m},{2m,3m}; n3,n4 are independent sourceless currents, all four independent. Set p=tanh(beta)^2. The original all-four-connected event in n1+n2 has probability p^m. The independent clusters C(n1+n3,0), C(n2+n4,2m) intersect with probability p^m[1+m(1-p)]. Therefore no graph- and scale-uniform c>0 gives original_probability>=c*sprinkled_probability. The four source distances are comparable to m. This refutes a quantitative reverse bridge only; both probabilities vanish at fixed beta, and the full critical Z^3 conjecture is untouched.
